description: Searches captured responses for any encoding of `value` (raw, URL-, JSON-, or HTML-escaped). Returns ranked candidates with the matched variant, score, and a short snippet, to locate the request that returns a data point. Also finds split matches: when `value` has several words (for example, a full name) and a response carries each word in a separate field, the candidate has `splitMatch: true`; prove those per field (one redaction per part). Response bodies stay server-side.
name: find_requests_containing
